recommendation: Keep the source fix. Revisit FHIR-50087 separately when that issue is in scope, especially for the outstanding THO move and category binding-strength decision.
issue_request: FHIR-44475 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to extend ActorDefinition actor types beyond the former person/system split, covering software systems and non-system actors such as individuals, patients, practitioners, related persons, physical devices, collectives, care teams, groups, healthcare services, and organizations.
initial_application: PR 3299 and commit 21ec201162 applied the original issue by changing ActorDefinition and ExampleScenario actor type wording and examples. Subsequent source history moved the detailed hierarchy into ActorDefinition-owned terminology, then FHIR-50087 split the model into a required high-level ActorDefinition.type and detailed ActorDefinition.category. The current source still retained active descriptions saying the vocabulary was only system or human.
additional_context: ActorDefinition is active and normative in source/fhir.ini, and ActorDefinition.category is listed as an R5-R6 addition. FHIR-50087 is a later Resolved - change required issue that explains the current type/category split and leaves the THO move and any category binding-strength adjustment for separate application.
reconciliation: Changed the active ActorDefinition StructureDefinition binding description and the actor-type and actor-code CodeSystem/ValueSet descriptions so high-level type text no longer says only system or human and the detailed vocabulary is described as non-system actor categories.
source_changes: source/actordefinition/structuredefinition-ActorDefinition.xml: updated ActorDefinition.type binding description to describe a high-level kind of entity acting as an actor.
source/actordefinition/codesystem-actordefinition-actor-type.xml: updated the CodeSystem description to match the high-level person/system/collective/other type set.
source/actordefinition/valueset-actordefinition-actor-type.xml: updated the ValueSet description to match the high-level actor type set.
source/actordefinition/codesystem-actordefinition-actor-code.xml: updated the CodeSystem description to identify detailed non-system actor categories.
source/actordefinition/valueset-actordefinition-actor-code.xml: updated the ValueSet description to identify detailed non-system actor categories.
